text: I went to have a molar extracted. The dentist explained every step of the procedure (so I could prepare myself) and took an X-ray beforehand to make sure it was the right tooth. Initially, I was worried that a molar extraction might cause side effects like gum bruising, but the dentist used gentle tools and proceeded slowly, not rushing, so it wasn't very painful. I didn't even realize it was over when the extraction was finished; I thought there were still many steps involved. The whole process took about half an hour. The cost of extracting each tooth varies; mine, for a molar, was a little over a thousand baht. Payment can be made via bank transfer, and the clinic provides a receipt.
